figures.title: 示例查询的几个部分
figures.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,SUM(-quantity_delta) sold FROM stock_movements WHERE movement_type='sale' AND movement_date BETWEEN '2025-10-03' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY warehouse_id,product_id) SELECT i.warehouse_id,i.product_id,i.quantity,COALESCE(s.sold,0) sold_units,i.quantity*i.unit_cost_cents stock_value_cents,ROUND(90.0*i.quantity/NULLIF(s.sold,0),2) cover_days FROM inventory_snapshots i JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id LEFT JOIN s ON s.warehouse_id=i.warehouse_id AND s.product_id=i.product_id WHERE p.active=1 AND i.snapshot_date='2025-12-31' AND i.quantity*i.unit_cost_cents>500000 AND COALESCE(s.sold,0)<20 ORDER BY stock_value_cents DESC, product_name

parts.label: 中间结果
parts.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,SUM(-quantity_delta) sold FROM stock_movements WHERE movement_type='sale' AND movement_date BETWEEN '2025-10-03' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY warehouse_id,product_id)
parts.note: 先单独算出一张临时结果 s，下面的查询可以把它当作普通表来用。

parts.label: 来源
parts.sql: FROM inventory_snapshots i JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id LEFT JOIN s ON s.warehouse_id=i.warehouse_id AND s.product_id=i.product_id
parts.note: 数据来自 表 inventory_snapshots、表 products、中间结果 s，并用 ON 后面的条件把它们的行配起来。

parts.label: 筛选
parts.sql: WHERE p.active=1 AND i.snapshot_date='2025-12-31' AND i.quantity*i.unit_cost_cents>500000 AND COALESCE(s.sold,0)<20
parts.note: 只保留满足这个条件的行：p.active=1 AND i.snapshot_date='2025-12-31' AND i.quantity*i.unit_co…。

parts.label: 排序
parts.note: 按 stock_value_cents DESC, product_name 排列结果。
